# Shanaim Shourov

## About

I build end-to-end web applications — from pixel-precise interfaces to scalable backend integrations. I love minimalism and brutalist design, and I believe the best code is the kind nobody notices.

## Technologies

- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript
- Libraries & Frameworks: React, Next.js, Vue.js, Node.js, Express.js
- Styling & UI: Tailwind CSS, ShadCN/UI
- Databases & Tools: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma, Zod

## Experience

- **Software Developer, LocalStaffing** (May 2025 – Present): Building an advertising campaign management dashboard (React, TypeScript, TanStack Query), an AI-powered content generation feature using the Anthropic API, a job recruitment platform, and a commission calculation/payment management module.
- **Software Engineer, Jukto Digital** (August 2023 – February 2026): Built and maintained a Learning Management System and Student Management System in React, designed reusable component libraries, and optimized application performance and accessibility.

## Core Competencies

Full-stack web development, responsive UI/UX design, RESTful API development and integration, database design and optimization, performance optimization, effective collaboration and communication.
